menu_options.bridge: Hue bridge (from the Philips Hue integration)

bridge.title: Choose a Hue bridge
bridge.description: Hue Studio reuses the connection of the Philips Hue integration, so no extra pairing is needed.

sync_box.title: Hue Play HDMI Sync Box
sync_box.description: Pair the box with Hue Studio, or use it through the Sync Box integration that already has it. One box is used one way only.

sync_box_pair.title: Hue Play HDMI Sync Box
sync_box_pair.description: Enter the address of the Sync Box. You will then hold its button to pair it with Hue Studio.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the Sync Box in your network.

sync_box_integration.title: Use the Sync Box integration
sync_box_integration.description: Hue Studio uses the entities and service of the Sync Box integration for this box: nothing to pair, and its entities stay as they are.

sync_box_use_integration.title: {name}
sync_box_use_integration.description: {name} is already set up in the Sync Box integration ({entry}). Hue Studio will use it through that integration instead of pairing it a second time.

sync_box_confirm.title: {name}
sync_box_confirm.description: Pair {name} with Hue Studio? Next, you will hold the button on the box.

sync_box_retry.title: {name}
sync_box_retry.description: Make sure the box is on, then try again and hold its button until the LED blinks green.

reauth_confirm.title: {name}
reauth_confirm.description: {name} no longer accepts Hue Studio (it may have been reset). Pair it again by holding its button.

abort.already_configured: This is already set up in Hue Studio.
abort.bridge_not_found: The selected Hue bridge is no longer available.
abort.no_bridges: No Philips Hue bridge with API v2 is configured. Set up the Philips Hue integration first.
abort.not_sync_box: This device is not a Sync Box.
abort.reauth_successful: The Sync Box is paired again.
abort.sync_box_not_found: The selected Sync Box is no longer available.

progress.press_button: Hold the button on {name} for about 3 seconds, until the LED blinks green.

error.cannot_connect: No Sync Box answered at this address.
error.link_timeout: The button was not held in time, or the box did not answer.

hue_entry_missing.message: The Philips Hue config entry used by Hue Studio no longer exists. Remove and re-add Hue Studio.

bridge_auth_failed.message: The Hue bridge rejected the app key of the Philips Hue integration. Re-authenticate the Philips Hue integration first.

bridge_unreachable.message: Cannot connect to the Hue bridge at {host}.

not_hue_light.message: {entity_id} is not a Hue light on a bridge connected to Hue Studio.

command_failed.message: The Hue bridge did not accept the command for {entity_id}.

not_hue_scene.message: {entity_id} is not a Hue scene on a bridge connected to Hue Studio.

scene_not_resettable.message: {entity_id} has no palette to reset it from.

sync_box_auth_failed.message: The Sync Box rejected Hue Studio. Pair it again.

sync_box_unreachable.message: Cannot connect to the Sync Box at {host}.

not_sync_box.message: {entity_id} does not belong to a Sync Box in Hue Studio.

lights_syncing.message: {entity_id} are syncing with an entertainment area right now.

sync_box_entry_missing.message: The Sync Box integration entry used by Hue Studio no longer exists. Remove and re-add the box in Hue Studio.

sync_box_entry_not_loaded.message: The Sync Box integration ({name}) is not loaded yet.

sync_box_integration_unavailable.message: The Sync Box integration cannot control {name} right now.

apply_palette.name: Apply palette
apply_palette.description: Applies a palette to Hue lights: gradient lights get the whole palette, other lights one color each.

gallery_scene.name: Gallery scene
gallery_scene.description: ID of a scene from the bundled gallery.

mirek.name: White temperature
mirek.description: Color temperature in mired, for a white palette.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: Brightness in percent. Defaults to the palette's own brightness.

set_gradient.name: Set gradient
set_gradient.description: Sets the color points of Hue gradient lights.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: How the points are spread over the light.

set_effect.name: Set effect
set_effect.description: Plays a light effect (candle, fireplace, sparkle, …) with its color, speed and brightness.

effect.name: Effect
effect.description: The effect to play; No effect stops it.

xy_color.name: Color
xy_color.description: CIE xy color of the effect, e.g. [0.55, 0.4].

mirek.name: White temperature
mirek.description: Color temperature of the effect in mired.

save_scene.name: Save scene
save_scene.description: Stores what the scene's lights show now in the Hue scene; optionally renames it and sets its dynamic speed and auto-play.

speed.name: Dynamic speed
speed.description: Speed of the dynamic scene in percent.

auto_dynamic.name: Auto-play
auto_dynamic.description: Start the scene dynamically whenever it is activated.

reset_scene.name: Reset scene
reset_scene.description: Rebuilds the light settings of a Hue scene from its palette and activates it.

shuffle.name: Shuffle colors
shuffle.description: Spread the palette colors over the lights in random order.

recall_scene.name: Play scene
recall_scene.description: Activates a Hue scene dynamically (colors keep changing) or statically, regardless of its auto-play setting.

dynamic.name: Dynamic
dynamic.description: Play the scene's palette dynamically; off shows it statically.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: Brightness in percent instead of the scene's own.

set_sync.name: Set Sync Box
set_sync.description: Changes a Hue Play HDMI Sync Box in one command: power, light sync, mode, intensity, HDMI input, entertainment area and brightness.

power.name: Power
power.description: On: HDMI passes through; off: power save.

sync.name: Light sync
sync.description: Start or stop syncing the lights.

mode.name: Sync mode
mode.description: Video, music or game; picking a mode starts syncing in it.

input.name: HDMI input
input.description: input1-input4 or the name you gave the input.

entertainment_area.name: Entertainment area
entertainment_area.description: Name or id of the entertainment area to sync.

menu_options.group_select: Hue rooms and zones → HA areas

group_select.title: Hue rooms and zones
group_select.description: Pick a Hue room or zone to choose which Home Assistant area it belongs to.

group_target.title: {group}
group_target.description: Automatic: the Hue group becomes the room of the area with exactly the same lights, otherwise it is shown as a zone. Pick an area to merge it with that room, or Zone to always show it as a zone.

room_select.title: Sensors in rooms
room_select.description: Pick a room to attach motion and temperature sensors to it.

room_sensors.title: {room}
room_sensors.description: Motion sensors show presence on the room card. Temperature sensors are averaged into the room temperature; a Hue motion sensor's own thermometer can be combined with the room's thermostat.

abort.no_groups: No Hue rooms, zones or areas with Hue lights were found.
